body: Observed 2026-10-01 at reviewed public corpus source043cd2e612d2216e28a9bca34925b5d04c37a664, Core rc.1 build163 / Tasks build202. Existing DCP038..042 literal anchors cover only partial semantics: new typed CLI test parses arguments, MCP schema test loops production tools without invoking every operation; retirement/index overflow, full-receipt Compare changes and real listener cancellation with an in-flight request lack discriminating witnesses.
